DLG-SC-LOC-002-11-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-11-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。館内で何をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-11-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. What are you looking for in the building?

DLG-SC-LOC-002-11-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-11-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 展示とお土産の売場を見たいです。ただ、バスの集合まで二十分しかありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-11-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 展示と買物を希望するがバス集合まで二十分と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-11-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to see the exhibition and souvenir shop. However, I only have twenty minutes until the bus meeting time.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-11-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to see the exhibition and shop, but have only twenty minutes until meeting the bus.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-11-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-11-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 展示の一回の案内は三十分ほどです。集合場所へ戻る時間も必要ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-11-001-SHARED-03.translation: One guided visit to the exhibition takes about thirty minutes. You also need time to return to the meeting point.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-11-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-11-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 展示を最後まで見てから戻るのは難しそうです。今日は買物だけに変えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-11-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 展示の所要時間では厳しいと理解し、今日は買物だけにすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-11-001-SHARED-04.translation: It looks difficult to see the whole exhibition and then get back. I'd like to change my plans to shopping only today.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-11-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you understand the exhibition takes too long, so you will only shop today.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-11-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-11-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 売場はこの階です。バスの集合場所は、どちらに指定されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-11-001-SHARED-05.translation: The shop is on this floor. Where have you been told to meet the bus?

DLG-SC-LOC-002-11-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-11-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 入口の前です。買物を十五分以内に終え、五分は戻る時間に残したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-11-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 集合は入口前で、買物十五分と帰路五分に分けたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-11-001-SHARED-06.translation: In front of the entrance. I'd like to finish shopping within fifteen minutes and leave five minutes to get back.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-11-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the meeting point is in front of the entrance, and you want fifteen minutes for shopping and five for returning.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-11-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-11-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この売場からその入口へは、案内図の右側の通路で戻れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-11-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can return from this shop to that entrance using the passage on the right of the guide map.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-11-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-11-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 右の通路を使います。展示の入場券は今日は買わず、お土産だけ会計します。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-11-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 右通路で戻り、展示券は買わずお土産のみ会計すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-11-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll use the passage on the right. I won't buy an exhibition ticket today, and will pay only for souvenirs.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-11-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will return by the right-hand passage, skip the exhibition ticket, and pay only for souvenirs.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-11-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-11-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。展示を後で見たい時のために案内資料はお渡しできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-11-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. We can give you information for when you'd like to see the exhibition another time.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-11-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-11-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 資料だけいただきます。展示は次の機会にして、今日は買物を済ませ入口へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-11-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 展示資料を希望し、見学は次回にして買物後に入口へ戻ると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-11-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll just take the information. I'll leave the exhibition for another time, finish shopping today, and return to the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-11-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for the exhibition information in Japanese and confirm you will visit another time, shop today, and return to the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-11-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-11-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、集合時刻に間に合うようお進みください。ご来館ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-11-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, please make your way back in time for the meeting. Thank you for visiting.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-12-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-12-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。ご利用について何を確認したいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-12-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. What would you like to check about using our facilities?

DLG-SC-LOC-002-12-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-12-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ロッカーに百円とあります。入浴料とは別に、毎回百円を払うものですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-12-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ロッカーの百円表示が入浴料とは別の毎回料金か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-12-001-SHARED-02.translation: The locker says 100 yen. Is that a fee I pay every time, separately from admission to the baths?
DLG-SC-LOC-002-12-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether the locker's 100-yen sign means a fee each time in addition to bathing admission.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-12-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-12-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: このロッカーは百円を入れ、使用後に戻る方式です。入浴料には含まれない追加料金という意味ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-12-001-SHARED-03.translation: You insert 100 yen in this locker and get it back after use. It does not mean an extra charge outside the bathing admission.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-12-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-12-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 戻る百円なんですね。硬貨がないので、千円札を小銭に替えられる場所を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-12-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 戻る硬貨と理解し、小銭がないため千円の両替場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-12-001-SHARED-04.translation: So the 100 yen is returned. I don't have coins, so I'd like to know where I can change a 1,000-yen note.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-12-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you understand the coin is returned, and ask where to change 1,000 yen because you have no coins.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-12-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-12-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今日は受付で両替できます。千円を百円硬貨十枚に替えましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-12-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can change it at reception today. Shall I exchange 1,000 yen for ten 100-yen coins?

DLG-SC-LOC-002-12-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-12-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。十枚のうち一枚をロッカーで使い、残りは財布にしまいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-12-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 千円を百円十枚に両替し、一枚を使用して残りを財布にしまうと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-12-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, please. I'll use one of the ten coins for the locker and put the rest in my wallet.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-12-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to change 1,000 yen into ten 100-yen coins, and say you will use one and put the rest in your wallet.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-12-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-12-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらが十枚です。鍵を戻すと百円が出るので、お帰りに取り忘れないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-12-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here are ten coins. When you return the key, the 100 yen comes out, so please remember to take it when leaving.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-12-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-12-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 鍵と荷物だけ取って帰らず、硬貨の取出口も確認します。鍵は外へ持って帰らないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-12-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 荷物と鍵だけで帰らず硬貨も確認し、鍵は持帰らないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-12-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't just take my key and luggage and leave; I'll check the coin return too. I'm not supposed to take the key away, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-002-12-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will check the coin return rather than leaving with only the luggage and key, and confirm the key is not to be taken home.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-12-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-12-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、使用後は鍵を戻してください。ロッカー番号を覚えておくと見つけやすいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-12-001-SHARED-09.translation: Correct, please return the key after use. Remembering the locker number makes it easier to find.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-12-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-12-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 番号を控え、帰る時は荷物、鍵の返却、百円の受取りを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-12-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 番号を控え、退出時に荷物、鍵返却、百円受取りを確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-12-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll note the number, and when leaving I'll check my belongings, return the key, and collect my 100 yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-12-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will note the number and check your belongings, key return, and receipt of the 100 yen when leaving.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-12-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-12-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。入浴をお楽しみください。

DLG-SC-LOC-002-13-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-13-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。散策について何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-13-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with your walk?

DLG-SC-LOC-002-13-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-13-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 去年のパンフレットにある短い道を歩きたいです。今日も通れるか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-13-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 前年のパンフレットの短い道が今日通れるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-13-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to walk the short route in last year's brochure. I'd like to check whether it is open today too.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-13-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether the short route in last year's brochure can be used today.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-13-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-13-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その道は、いまの掲示では閉鎖中です。パンフレットのどの線をご覧になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-13-001-SHARED-03.translation: According to the current notice, that route is closed. Which line in the brochure were you looking at?

DLG-SC-LOC-002-13-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-13-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この赤い線です。短いから大丈夫だと思いましたが、古い案内だけで決めないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-13-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 赤線を示し、短距離でも古い案内だけで判断しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-13-001-SHARED-04.translation: This red line. I thought it would be all right because it's short, but I won't decide based only on old information.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-13-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point to the red line and say in Japanese that even for a short route you will not rely only on old information.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-13-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-13-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 距離の短さと、今日通れるかは別ですね。最新の案内では、この区間は利用できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-13-001-SHARED-05.translation: How short it is and whether it is open today are separate matters. The latest information says this section cannot be used.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-13-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-13-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 閉鎖中の道には入りません。別の山道を急いで選ぶより、今日は屋内で見られる展示を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-13-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 閉鎖道へ入らず別の山道を急いで選ばず、屋内展示を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-13-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't enter the closed route. Rather than hurriedly choosing another mountain path, I'd like to know about exhibitions I can see indoors today.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-13-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will avoid the closed path and not rush to choose another mountain route, and ask about indoor exhibitions.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-13-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-13-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この案内所の展示室を利用できます。登山の準備が必要な道へ行く代わりではなく、屋内の見学です。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-13-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can use the exhibition room at this information center. This is an indoor visit, rather than taking a route that requires hiking preparations.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-13-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-13-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 屋内の見学に変えます。同行者にも、赤い線の道は使わないと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-13-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 屋内見学へ変更し、同行者へ閉鎖道を使わないと連絡すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-13-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll change to an indoor visit. I'll also tell the people with me not to use the route marked by the red line.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-13-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will switch to an indoor visit and tell your companions not to use the closed route.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-13-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-13-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今日の通行案内をお渡しします。古いパンフレットと区別してお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-13-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll give you today's route information. Please keep it distinct from the old brochure.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-13-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-13-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 新しい案内に閉鎖区間を印し、古い地図だけでは歩きません。今日は展示室を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-13-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 新案内に閉鎖区間を印し古図だけで歩かず、今日は展示を見ると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-13-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll mark the closed section on the new information and won't walk using only the old map. I'll visit the exhibition room today.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-13-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will mark the closed section on the new guide, avoid relying only on the old map, and see the exhibition today.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-13-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-13-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。状況を確認していただきありがとうございます。どうぞご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-13-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Thank you for checking the conditions. Please enjoy the exhibition.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-14-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-14-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。公園で何をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-14-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What are you looking for in the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-002-14-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-14-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どものおむつを替えたいです。この近くのトイレに交換台はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-14-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 子どものおむつ交換のため、近くのトイレに交換台があるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-14-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to change my child's diaper. Does the nearby restroom have a changing table?
DLG-SC-LOC-002-14-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether the nearby restroom has a diaper-changing table for your child.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-14-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-14-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの小さいトイレにはありません。管理棟の設備をご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-14-001-SHARED-03.translation: The small restroom here does not. I can direct you to the facilities in the administration building.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-14-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-14-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: トイレがあるだけでは交換台もあるとは限らないんですね。管理棟までの場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-14-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: トイレと交換設備は別と理解し、管理棟の場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-14-001-SHARED-04.translation: So having a restroom doesn't necessarily mean there is a changing table. Please tell me where the administration building is.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-14-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you understand a restroom and changing facilities are different, and ask where the administration building is.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-14-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-14-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この地図の緑の建物です。入口に交換台のある部屋の表示があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-14-001-SHARED-05.translation: It's the green building on this map. At the entrance, there is a sign for the room with the changing table.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-14-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-14-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 緑の建物へ行きます。同行している父親が替えたいのですが、使える部屋を確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-14-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 緑の管理棟へ向かい、父親が使える交換室か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-14-001-SHARED-06.translation: We'll go to the green building. The child's father is with us and would like to do the changing; could we check whether he can use that room?
DLG-SC-LOC-002-14-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will go to the green administration building, and check whether the father can use the changing room.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-14-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-14-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その交換台の部屋は、利用する保護者の性別を問わず使える設備として案内しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-14-001-SHARED-07.translation: We list that changing-table room as a facility available to guardians regardless of gender.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-14-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-14-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: それなら父親と子どもが入ります。私は外で荷物を持って待ち、通路をふさがないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-14-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 父親と子どもが入り、自分は外で荷物を持ち通路を塞がず待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-14-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then the father and child will go in. I'll wait outside with the bags and make sure not to block the passage.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-14-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the father and child will enter, while you wait outside with the bags without blocking the passage.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-14-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-14-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 場所はこの入口です。使用中なら、空くまで入口の横でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-14-001-SHARED-09.translation: The room is at this entrance. If it is occupied, please wait beside the entrance until it becomes available.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-14-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-14-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 表示と使用中かを確認します。別の部屋へ勝手に入らず、案内された交換台を使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-14-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 表示と使用中の状況を確認し、指定された交換台を使うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-14-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the signs and whether it's occupied. I won't go into other rooms without permission, and will use the changing table you've indicated.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-14-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will check the signs and occupancy and use the designated changing table.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-14-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-14-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。管理棟の表示をご覧ください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-14-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please follow the signs in the administration building. Thank you for asking.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-15-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-15-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。ご予約について何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-15-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. How can I help you with your reservation?

DLG-SC-LOC-002-15-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-15-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二泊しますが、予約番号が二つあります。一泊だけと取り違えないよう、両方確認していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-15-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二泊分が別予約番号なので両件を確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-15-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm staying two nights, but have two booking numbers. Could you check both so it isn't mistaken for just a one-night stay?
DLG-SC-LOC-002-15-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for both bookings to be checked because the two nights have separate reservation numbers.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-15-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-15-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 一件ずつの日付を拝見します。同じお名前でご予約されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-15-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check the dates for each. Are both reservations under the same name?

DLG-SC-LOC-002-15-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-15-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 両方グエンです。今日の一泊と、明日の一泊を別々に予約しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-15-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同じ名義で今日一泊と明日一泊を別々に予約したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-15-001-SHARED-04.translation: Both are under Nguyen. I booked tonight and tomorrow night separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-15-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you made separate bookings under the same name for tonight and tomorrow night.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-15-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-15-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二件とも確認できました。部屋の種類も同じです。続けて同じ部屋を使えるか調べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-15-001-SHARED-05.translation: I've confirmed both. The room type is the same too. I'll check whether you can stay in the same room continuously.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-15-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-15-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。予約が二つだから必ず部屋を替えるとも、同じ部屋が確約されるとも思っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-15-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 部屋移動の必要も同室継続も決めつけず確認を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-15-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I'm not assuming that two bookings necessarily mean changing rooms, or that the same room is guaranteed.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-15-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to check without assuming either that a room change is needed or that staying in the same room is guaranteed.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-15-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-15-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今回は同じ部屋で二泊できます。ただし受付では二件の予約として確認済みです。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-15-001-SHARED-07.translation: For this stay, you can use the same room for two nights. However, reception has confirmed them as two separate reservations.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-15-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-15-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 同じ部屋で二泊できるんですね。明朝にチェックアウトして取り直す必要はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-15-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同室二泊が可能と理解し、翌朝チェックアウトの必要があるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-15-001-SHARED-08.translation: So I can stay in the same room for both nights. Do I need to check out and check in again tomorrow morning?
DLG-SC-LOC-002-15-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you understand you can stay in the same room for two nights, and ask whether checkout is necessary tomorrow morning.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-15-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-15-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今回は明朝の部屋退出は不要です。出発は二泊後の朝としてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-15-001-SHARED-09.translation: For this stay, you don't need to vacate the room tomorrow morning. We will explain your departure as the morning after two nights.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-15-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-15-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二つの予約を確認できました。明朝は部屋を空けず、二泊後にチェックアウトする内容でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-15-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二予約を確認し、翌朝退出不要で二泊後の出発と確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-15-001-SHARED-10.translation: We've confirmed both bookings. Please arrange it so I don't vacate the room tomorrow morning and check out after two nights.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-15-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese the two reservations, no need to leave tomorrow morning, and departure after two nights.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-15-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-15-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。二泊のご案内をお渡しします。ご滞在をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-15-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll give you the information for your two-night stay. Enjoy your stay.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-16-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-16-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。ご注文で何をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-16-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. What would you like to order?

DLG-SC-LOC-002-16-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-16-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二杯目の案内を見ました。おかわりが無料という意味ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-16-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二杯目の案内が無料のおかわりという意味か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-16-001-SHARED-02.translation: I saw the sign about a second cup. Does it mean a refill is free?
DLG-SC-LOC-002-16-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether the second-cup notice means a free refill.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-16-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-16-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは二杯目が割引価格になる案内で、無料ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-16-001-SHARED-03.translation: This sign means the second cup is discounted, not free.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-16-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-16-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 無料だと読み違えました。二杯目はいくらで、最初と同じ飲み物でなければいけませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-16-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 誤読を認め、価格と一杯目と同じ飲物の必要を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-16-001-SHARED-04.translation: I misread it as free. How much is the second cup, and does it have to be the same drink as the first?
DLG-SC-LOC-002-16-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge the misunderstanding in Japanese and ask the price and whether the drink must match the first cup.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-16-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-16-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この案内の対象なら三百円です。同じ飲み物でなくても、こちらの対象から選べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-16-001-SHARED-05.translation: If it's one of the drinks covered by this offer, it is 300 yen. It doesn't have to be the same drink; you can choose from these eligible items.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-16-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-16-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 対象の中の温かい紅茶にします。一杯目はコーヒーでしたが、二杯目は変えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-16-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 対象の温かい紅茶を選び、一杯目のコーヒーから変えたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-16-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll have the hot black tea included in the offer. My first drink was coffee, but I'd like to change for the second cup.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-16-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose the eligible hot black tea in Japanese and say you want to change from your first cup of coffee.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-16-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-16-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 紅茶で承りました。今のコーヒーカップに注ぐのではなく、別のカップでお持ちします。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-16-001-SHARED-07.translation: I've taken your order for black tea. We'll bring it in a separate cup rather than pouring it into your current coffee cup.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-16-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-16-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。まだ一杯目が少し残っているので、カップはそのまま置いてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-16-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別カップを希望し、一杯目が残るので元のカップを置いてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-16-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, please. There's still a little left of my first drink, so may I leave that cup here?
DLG-SC-LOC-002-16-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request a separate cup in Japanese and ask to keep the first cup because some drink remains.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-16-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-16-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、残っている分はそのままお飲みください。二杯目は別料金で加算します。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-16-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, please finish what's left as it is. We'll add a separate charge for the second cup.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-16-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-16-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一杯目を飲み終えてから紅茶を飲みます。二杯目の三百円も含めて、あとで会計します。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-16-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一杯目後に紅茶を飲み、二杯目三百円込みで後会計すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-16-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll finish the first drink before having the tea. I'll pay later, including the 300 yen for the second cup.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-16-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will have tea after finishing the first drink and pay later including the second cup's 300 yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-16-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-16-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。紅茶をお持ちします。どうぞごゆっくり。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-16-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll bring your tea. Please relax and enjoy.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-17-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-17-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。お食事で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-17-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. How can I help you with your meal?

DLG-SC-LOC-002-17-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-17-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもとラーメン一杯を分けたいです。取り分け用の小鉢をお願いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-17-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 子どもと一杯を分けるため取り分け小鉢を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-17-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to share one bowl of ramen with my child. Could we have a small bowl for sharing?
DLG-SC-LOC-002-17-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for a small sharing bowl so you can share one ramen with your child.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-17-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-17-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 小さいラーメンをもう一杯、というご注文でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-17-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are you ordering another small bowl of ramen?

DLG-SC-LOC-002-17-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-17-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ、料理は一杯だけです。空の小鉢に、私が子どもの分を分けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-17-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二杯目ではなく空の小鉢に自分で分けると訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-17-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, just one serving of food. I'd like an empty small bowl so I can put some aside for my child myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-17-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Correct the misunderstanding in Japanese: you want an empty small bowl to share the food yourself, not a second serving.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-17-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-17-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この注文では空の小鉢をご用意できます。小さいスプーンも必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-17-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can provide an empty small bowl with this order. Do you also need a small spoon?

DLG-SC-LOC-002-17-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-17-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、子ども用を一つお願いします。大人の私には普通のスプーンがあれば大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-17-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 子ども用小スプーン一つを希望し、自分は普通の物でよいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-17-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, one for my child, please. A normal spoon is fine for me as the adult.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-17-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for one small child's spoon and say a normal one is fine for you.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-17-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-17-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 普通のラーメン一杯と、空の小鉢、小さいスプーンですね。大盛りにはしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-17-001-SHARED-07.translation: One regular ramen, an empty small bowl, and a small spoon, correct? Would you like a large serving?

DLG-SC-LOC-002-17-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-17-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 大盛りにはしません。追加の麺も頼まず、普通の一杯のままでお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-17-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 大盛りや追加麺は不要で通常一杯を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-17-001-SHARED-08.translation: No large serving. I don't need extra noodles either; please keep it as one regular bowl.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-17-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you do not need a large serving or extra noodles, only one regular bowl.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-17-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-17-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。料理は一杯として、取り分け用品を添えてお持ちします。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-17-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. We'll bring one serving of food together with the sharing utensils.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-17-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-17-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一杯だけの注文と確認できました。小鉢は空で受け取り、食べられる量を私が分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-17-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 料理一杯と空小鉢を確認し、自分で子どもの分を取り分けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-17-001-SHARED-10.translation: We've confirmed that the order is just one bowl. I'll take the small bowl empty and portion out an amount my child can eat myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-17-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese one serving and an empty small bowl, and say you will portion out your child's share yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-17-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-17-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、その内容でお作りします。ご注文ありがとうございます。少々お待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-17-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, we'll prepare that order. Thank you. Please wait a moment.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-18-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-18-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。ご予約について何をご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-18-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. What would you like to discuss about your reservation?

DLG-SC-LOC-002-18-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-18-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 三人で予約したグエンです。一人増えて四人になりました。席を変更できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-18-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 三人予約に一人増え四人となったため席変更を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-18-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm Nguyen, with a reservation for three. One more person will join, making four. Can we change the table?
DLG-SC-LOC-002-18-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to change the seating because one extra person makes your reservation for three into four.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-18-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-18-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今の三人席に椅子を足すと通路が狭くなります。四人席の空きを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-18-001-SHARED-03.translation: Adding a chair to your current three-person table would narrow the aisle. I'll check for an available table for four.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-18-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-18-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 通路に無理に椅子を置かなくて大丈夫です。四人で座れる席がなければ、別の案も相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-18-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通路へ無理に椅子を足さず、適切な席がなければ別案を相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-18-001-SHARED-04.translation: You don't need to squeeze a chair into the aisle. If there's no suitable table for four, I'd like to discuss other options too.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-18-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese not to force an extra chair into the aisle, and that you want to discuss alternatives if suitable seating is unavailable.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-18-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-18-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 同じ時刻に使える四人席がありました。皆様同じ時刻に到着しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-18-001-SHARED-05.translation: There's a table for four available at the same time. Will everyone arrive together?

DLG-SC-LOC-002-18-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-18-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 三人は六時に来ます。追加の一人は六時半です。人数は四人ですが全員同時ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-18-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 三人は六時、一人は六時半で全員同時到着ではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-18-001-SHARED-06.translation: Three of us will come at six. The additional person will come at six thirty. There are four of us, but we won't all arrive together.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-18-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that three people arrive at six and one at six thirty, so the four will not arrive together.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-18-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-18-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 四人席に変更し、遅れて来る方が一人いると記録します。先に料理を注文しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-18-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll change it to a table for four and note that one person will arrive later. Would you like to order food first?

DLG-SC-LOC-002-18-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-18-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 先に三人分だけ相談します。四人分の料理を自動で始めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-18-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 最初は三人分の料理を相談し、四人分を自動で始めないよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-18-001-SHARED-08.translation: We'll discuss only three people's food initially. Please don't automatically start preparing food for four.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-18-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will initially discuss food for three, and ask not to start preparing four people's food automatically.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-18-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-18-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。席は四人、最初の注文は三人で伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-18-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. We'll seat four and take the initial order for three.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-18-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-18-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 席の人数と注文人数を分けて確認できました。遅れる人には予約名と六時半の到着を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-18-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 席四人と最初の注文三人を区別し、遅れる人へ予約名と時刻を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-18-001-SHARED-10.translation: We've distinguished the seating number from the initial order number. I'll tell the latecomer the booking name and the six-thirty arrival time.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-18-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese four seats versus the initial three-person order, and say you will give the latecomer the booking name and time.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-18-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-18-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、四人席でお待ちしています。ご連絡ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-18-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, we'll be waiting with a table for four. Thank you for letting us know.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-19-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-19-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。ご見学について何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-19-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with your visit?

DLG-SC-LOC-002-19-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-19-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 入口の「本日閉鎖」という紙を見ました。今日は全部見学できないのか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-19-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本日閉鎖の表示が全見学の終了か確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-19-001-SHARED-02.translation: I saw a notice at the entrance saying “Closed today.” I'd like to check whether nothing can be visited today.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-19-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to check whether “Closed today” means all visits are suspended.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-19-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-19-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その紙は休憩所についての掲示です。見学全体の終了ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-19-001-SHARED-03.translation: That notice concerns the rest area. It does not mean the entire visit is closed.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-19-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-19-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 休憩所だけなんですね。大きな見出しだけ読んで、全部閉まっていると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-19-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 休憩所のみと理解し、見出しだけで全閉鎖と誤読したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-19-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it's only the rest area. I read just the large heading and thought everything was closed.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-19-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you now understand only the rest area is closed, and explain that reading just the heading caused your misunderstanding.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-19-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-19-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 対象は紙の下にある建物名です。地図では、この青い印の建物になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-19-001-SHARED-05.translation: The building name at the bottom of the paper identifies what it applies to. On the map, it's this building marked in blue.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-19-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-19-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 青い建物を避ければよいんですね。休憩所の中を通り抜ける道も使わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-19-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 青い対象建物を避け、その中の通抜けも使わないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-19-001-SHARED-06.translation: So I should avoid the blue building. I'll also avoid the route passing through the rest area.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-19-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that you will avoid the blue building and not use the passage through it.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-19-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-19-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、入口の閉鎖表示がある道には入らず、こちらの順路をご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-19-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, please don't enter paths with closure signs at their entrances, and use this visitor route.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-19-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-19-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらの順路で見学します。同行者に全体が閉鎖と伝えたので、休憩所だけだったと訂正します。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-19-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 指定順路を使い、同行者へ全閉鎖という誤情報を訂正すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-19-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll follow this visitor route. I told my companions everything was closed, so I'll correct that and explain it was only the rest area.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-19-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will use the indicated route and correct the mistaken information you gave your companions about everything being closed.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-19-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-19-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 必要なら対象の建物を示した地図をお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-19-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you need it, I can give you a map showing the relevant building.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-19-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-19-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 地図をいただきます。閉鎖の対象を確認し、見学できる順路だけ歩きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-19-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 対象建物の地図を希望し、許可された見学順路を歩くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-19-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'd like the map, please. I'll check what the closure applies to and walk only along the route open to visitors.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-19-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for the map showing the affected building and say you will use only the permitted visitor route.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-19-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-19-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。静かにご見学ください。ご来訪ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-19-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please visit quietly. Thank you for coming.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-20-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-20-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: おはようございます。ご訪問について何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-20-001-SHARED-01.translation: Good morning. How can I help you with your visit?

DLG-SC-LOC-002-20-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-20-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 担当者と打合せを予約しています。現場の写真も必要ですが、まず受付で許可を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-20-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 打合せ予約があり写真も必要だが、受付で許可を先に確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-20-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have a meeting booked with the person responsible. I also need site photographs, but I'd like to check permission at reception first.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-20-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have a meeting appointment and also need photos, but want to check permission at reception first.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-20-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-20-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約のメールをお願いします。打合せの場所は事務所となっていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-20-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show me the booking email. The meeting location is the office, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-002-20-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-20-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: このメールです。事務所の予約なので、作業区域にも自由に入れるとは考えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-20-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 事務所予約のメールを示し、作業区域への自由入場とは考えていないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-20-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here is the email. Since it's an office appointment, I don't assume it gives me free access to the work area.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-20-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the email for the office appointment and say in Japanese that you do not consider it permission to enter the work area freely.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-20-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-20-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、作業区域への入場と撮影は別の確認が必要です。写真は何に使う予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-20-001-SHARED-05.translation: Correct, entry to the work area and photography require separate checks. What do you plan to use the photographs for?

DLG-SC-LOC-002-20-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-20-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 社内の進捗報告用です。ほかの作業員や設備も写る可能性があるので、撮る前に範囲を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-20-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 写真は社内進捗報告用で人や設備が写り得るため、撮影範囲を先に尋ねたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-20-001-SHARED-06.translation: An internal progress report. Other workers and equipment might appear, so I'd like to ask about the permitted scope before taking any photos.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-20-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the photos are for an internal progress report and may show people or equipment, so you want to ask the permitted scope first.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-20-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-20-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当へ目的と希望を伝えます。確認まで事務所の待合せ場所でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-20-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll tell the person responsible your purpose and request. Please wait in the office meeting area until we confirm.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-20-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-20-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ここで待ちます。撮影の返事がないうちは、区域へ入ったりカメラを向けたりしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-20-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 許可確認まで待ち、区域入場や撮影を行わないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-20-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll wait here. Until I receive a response about photography, I won't enter the area or point my camera at it.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-20-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will wait for permission confirmation without entering the area or taking photographs.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-20-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-20-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当から、今日は事務所で資料を見ながら打合せすると回答がありました。現場への入場はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-20-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person responsible has replied that today's meeting will use documents in the office. There will be no entry to the site.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-20-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-20-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は事務所の資料で進捗を確認します。現場写真は撮らず、必要なら別の日の確認方法を打合せで相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-20-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日は事務所資料で確認して現場撮影はせず、別日の方法を打合せで相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-20-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check progress using the office documents today. I won't take site photographs, and if necessary I'll discuss another day's method of checking during the meeting.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-20-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that today you will use office documents and not photograph the site, and will discuss arrangements for another day at the meeting if needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-20-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-20-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当へご案内します。受付で確認いただきありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-20-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll show you to the person responsible. Thank you for checking at reception.
